chapters.title: Module Roadmap and Copilot Chat Foundations

sections.transcript:

Let's get started. What have we? M365 Copilot Chat. That is the focus of today.

sections.title: What M365 Copilot Chat Is
sections.instructions:
### Focus
Define Copilot Chat correctly as an assistant and introduce grounding at a high level.

### Emphasize
- Prompt specificity drives output quality
- Copilot needs explicit instructions
- Grounding adds context beyond base model knowledge
sections.transcript:
### Definition
What is it? First of all, if we talk about M365 Copilot Chat, it is our AI assistant. What is an AI assistant? Well, it's in the word. It's still an assistant.

### Key Principle
You need to instruct Copilot to do exactly what you want. Ask very specifically what you want to get out of Copilot and what you want to as a result. That's very important.

That's what we are going to learn today. On the other hand, we see something that is major important and that is grounding. We are going to ground Copilot conversations by using work and by using web-related data.

There are two ways that we can ground Copilot. Now, what is grounding? Grounding is adding additional information to those large language models. Again, a very specific term here, large language models.

sections.title: LLMs Behind Copilot Chat
sections.instructions:
### Focus
Explain what a large language model is in practical terms.

### Cover
- LLMs run behind modern AI tools
- Copilot uses GPT-family models
- Current model examples: GPT-5 and GPT-5.2
sections.transcript:
### Model Context
A large language model, that's what you use behind the scenes. If you use Copilot, if you use any other AI tool you use nowadays, a large language model that has been trained on a very large set of data. The models that we use for now are GPT-5, GPT-5.2. These well-known GPT models are used behind the scenes if you're going to interact with M365 Copilot chat.

sections.title: Grounding with Web and Work Data
sections.instructions:
### Focus
Clarify why grounding is needed and how web grounding differs from work grounding.

### Cover
- LLM training data is broad but time-bounded
- Fresh information requires retrieval
- Web grounding pulls from web sources
- Work grounding pulls from Microsoft 365 content within tenant boundaries
sections.transcript:
### Why Grounding Matters
Now again, a large language model has been trained on a data set. A data set that they took from the internet. Everything that was publicly available.

Think about articles. Think about the complete internet, but also social media conversations, books. They took that complete data set and they trained a model to understand human language, natural language.

That's what these models are very good at. Now, the large language model has a data set that is used to train the model up until a certain point in time. That's why if you're going to ask Copilot a question about today's news, it does not know about that.

It needs to reach out to something else to fetch that information and bring back that result. That specific concept, that's what we call grounding. If you're going to do web grounding, that means that Copilot is going to fetch information from the web.

If you're going to do work grounding, that means you are going to fetch information from your work related content. What's that? M365. The boundary that we have there is your Microsoft 365 boundary.

I will exactly explain what that looks like. This is what we are going to do in the first module. We are going to see what is it.

sections.title: Baseline Availability in Microsoft 365
sections.instructions:
### Focus
Set licensing baseline for participants before comparing advanced options.

### Cover
- M365 Copilot Chat is included with qualifying Microsoft 365 subscriptions
- Applies to users already licensed for apps like Word, Excel, Teams, and Outlook
sections.transcript:
### Availability
First of all, M365 Copilot chat is available at no cost to your Microsoft 365 subscription. If you're using already Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook, you have one of the other Microsoft 365 licenses. With that, you have access to M365 Copilot chat.

sections.title: M365 Copilot Chat Interface and Add-on Value
sections.instructions:
### Focus
Walk through where to access M365 Copilot Chat and clarify differences between base M365 access and the add-on Copilot license.

### Cover
- Access URL and sign-in requirement
- M365 Copilot Chat vs individual Copilot interface
- Auto model selection and response modes
- In-app Copilot chat in Word/Excel/PowerPoint
- Work-data access as the key differentiator of the add-on license
sections.transcript:
### License Context
That is the benefit of having that license. Now, you can add an additional Copilot license. That's then what we call the M365 Copilot license.

That's in addition to your standard M365 subscription. What is included in the M365 Copilot chat? If I would introduce you now to the interface, and I will tell you how you get to this interface, this is the M365 Copilot chat interface. How do you get there? Very important.

I'm going to show you how you get there. It's one of the URLs that you need to remember. That's m365copilot.com. M365copilot.com is the most important thing that you need to remember of today.

This is how you get access to that M365 Copilot chat interface. Yes, you need to sign in. Why? You need to have an active M365 account to get access to that Copilot chat environment.

### Interface Differences
Some of you may have used Copilot.Microsoft.com. This is not the focus of today. This is something else. This is what we call the Copilot individual user.

If you are using this interface, that's the individual interface where you have some limitations. You can create X amount of podcasts, you can generate images, you can interact with Copilot, but you will find out that you have some limitations. Also there, you can add an additional license, but it's beyond the scope of this training.

We focus on this interface. Now I told you already this M365 Copilot license is an add-on license. I will show you what the difference is, but if we look at the M365 Copilot chat experience, what's included? You are able to chat with the latest and greatest GPT models.

Each time that you're going to go into that Copilot chat interface, you will see at the top right of your screen, there is an auto selection of the model behind the scenes in the background that we will use. You can change it to quick response, think deeper, which are two different ways that Copilot is going to provide you information, or you can select the GPT 5.2 model that is doing the same, the quick response, and think deeper capability. Automatically, the model that suits your needs based on the prompt that you're going to put in will be selected in the background, so you don't have to worry about that.

### In-App Experience and Key Difference
You can also use in your Word, Excel, PowerPoint applications, you can also use Copilot chat experience in there. Let's say I want to create a new Word document. Again, I don't have any license.

The only license that I have is an M365 license, so I can use Word, I can use Outlook, I can use Excel, and so on. What have you here is that we have this Copilot button, and by the way, you will find this Copilot option everywhere. You have it in Word, you have it in Excel, you have it inside of your Edge browser, it will show up everywhere.

This experience, it's the same experience as what you have in the Copilot chat experience. This is very important. The prompts, the questions that you're going to put in in this prompt box here, the result is exactly the same as what you would use in this Copilot chat experience.

What exactly is the difference then? Well, if you have a M365 Copilot license, which is that add-on license, you would be able to ask questions about work-related data, not only web, also work. If you are going to use your M365 license, you can use Copilot chat with web data, and this is already a lot. Don't get me wrong here, but the biggest difference is that you have access to work-related data if you're going to use Copilot chat, if you're going to use Agents, and if you have built other advanced management systems.
